description: BeschleunigerBallett's Renovate config. Everything shared lives in the preset at ANTfrastructure's repository root (default.json); the `extends` line below is the whole adoption, exactly as in OmniAccelerANT and jotrockenmitlocken.

The part this repo cannot get any other way is the git-submodules manager, which Renovate DISABLES by default. This repo carries fifteen gitlinks - two owned (third_party/ANTfrastructure and third_party/OxidANT, both tracking `develop`) and thirteen vendored - and not one of them has ever had a bump proposed by anything. The hub gitlink is the expensive one: the Linux and Windows lanes run the gates that live behind that pin, so a stale gitlink means CI grades this tree with whatever the hub looked like the last time someone moved it by hand.

The local Renovate driver checks every direct gitlink against its remote default branch and applies its exact tip, regardless of the .gitmodules branch setting or Renovate report rows. FUZZTEST's release branch setting remains for the separate git-sync-branches.sh command.

Actions: the preset's helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests pins the third-party actions by digest, the version as a trailing comment (applied 2026-10-07: actions/checkout v7.0.1, actions/upload-artifact v7.0.1, actions/download-artifact v8.0.1, codecov/codecov-action v7.1.1), while a preset rule explicitly leaves the six Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure composite actions and its three reusable workflows at @develop for the upstream-first change flow.

Unlike the three sibling consumers, this repo has never carried a .github/dependabot.yml, so adopting the preset is a pure addition here - there is no hand-over to sequence and nothing to delete afterwards.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure` from ANTfrastructure's DEFAULT BRANCH, not from the pin in third_party/ANTfrastructure, so a preset change reaches this repo only after it is merged there. And the Renovate GitHub App is NOT installed on this repository and will not be (owner decision, 2026-09-09), so no bot will ever author a commit here. That does not make this file idle: ANTfrastructure's linux/scripts/renovate-local.sh reads exactly it.

The CMake pins in third_party/CMakeLists.txt are read by the PRESET's customManagers since 2026-10-01 (hub CON46); a second CMake manager here would report every pin twice, and `renovate-local.sh --apply` refuses a pin reported twice. abseil-cpp (ABSL_TAG, versioning=loose for its LTS dates) and microsoft/GSL are read through the `# renovate:` annotation above each; googletest through its release-tag archive URL. Corrosion is pinned to a commit because v0.6.1 lacks fixes this build needs, so nothing tracks it until the next tag.

Keep the ABSL_TAG comment above the pin in mind when taking a bump: the tag must stay >= the one FUZZTEST pins in third_party/FUZZTEST/cmake/BuildDependencies.cmake. Moving abseil UP is always safe for that constraint; moving it down is not.
